description:
👇 Download our Free Guide: 'The 3 Paths to Maui' 👇

What does it mean to Retire WITH Maui, not just visit it?

A full move. A second home. Or a vacation rental that covers its own costs. Three real paths, and most couples don't know which one fits until someone walks them through it honestly.

We're Jonny, the Native Hawaiian, & Danny, the transplant from MN, of dreams2REALITY Hawaii. Using our Compass framework, we help lifestyle-driven couples nearing retirement find which version of Maui belongs in their future, then make it happen.

Three times a week on the Maui 'Hot List' Hulahan, our flagship show, we cover new listings and deals, legislation and rental rules, the true cost of ownership, and what daily life on the island actually looks like.

We'd rather give you an honest answer than a hopeful one.

🧭 Free Aloha Vision Quest call: bit.ly/avq-booking
📋 Free guide, The 3 Paths to Maui: bit.ly/maui-3paths-yt

Jonny Brath & Danny Rude | dreams2REALITY Hawaii | 📍 Maui, Hawai'i
